g.text: Any of three triggers starts one decision loop. It measures the gap, scores every holding, builds a plan, waits for your approval, then
⏰ Every morning at 09:00 UTC — the scheduler runs a check on its own
💬 You ask for a run — /run in Telegram (or a menu button)
🌐 An HTTP call — POST /run-now, from a script or another service
one thread per run · state kept, so it can pause for hours
Add up retired and held tons against your cap and audit
date → urgency: none / low / medium / high
Each holding: weather (fire, flood, heat) + reputation
(sanctions, fraud, lawsuits) → a risk score from 0 to 100
Retire risky or held credits, buy & retire, or buy & hold —
ranked by credibility, price and urgency, then trimmed to
The run pauses. Approve all, deny, pick per action, or
change amounts in plain words. Nothing moves without you.
Wallet check → retire / buy & retire / buy & hold. Not
enough money is a hard stop (HTTP 402), never a silent
Telegram summary + email backup — including shortfalls,
errors and whether the email really went out
DECISION CORE — the maths behind the plan
Days to audit × how much is still missing →
urgency. It only proposes actions on medium
reputation. 70+ is high risk, 40+ is medium.
Three searches: same region, same category,
branch out. Merge, rank, and drop anything
urgency. Cheap, trusted, and needed now
Buys are cut to what the wallet can pay.
Retiring credits you already own is free, so
Before a buy & hold, it checks fire, flood
and heat risk for that specific project —
LOCAL STATE — a plain folder of JSON files, locked while writing
cap · audit months · wallet · chat id ·
project, region, registry, vintage · also a
NCT / BCT price · falls back to $0.227
fire, flood and heat risk for a region
credibility news search · neutral if keys
Solid arrow — the main path, one step to the next.
Dashed arrow — this step reads a file, or calls a tool.
Glass sheet — a group of helpers, not a step of its own.
NOBRAC · Net-zero Offset Brokerage & Retirement Automation Control — LangGraph, FastAPI, Telegram and a simulated wallet.
